description: Synthetic load and PV generation profiles for energy community coalition formation (LPG-derived, 15-minute resolution, full year) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marek Kollmann, Čeněk Šváb (Brno University of Technology). This dataset accompanies the journal article "Energy community coalitionformation: Why full-resolution data outweighs solver optimality undertemporal and consumer compression" (submitted to Energy, manuscriptEGY-D-26-05934). It supports reproduction of the reported figures andtables, and provides a benchmark for new algorithms that assignprosumers and consumers to legally compliant energy-community groupsunder cardinality caps. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
